description: Lists the signed-in person's own unpublished drafts, as the organizer dashboard's draft list does: for each its `eventId`, `name`, `kind`, `createdAtMs` and `lastActivityAtMs`, newest activity first, at most 20, with `openDrafts` and the `cap` (5 unpublished drafts per verified phone). Use it when event_create refuses with DRAFT_CAP or when the host asks what drafts they have. A published event does not appear. It requires a personal connector token.
name: event_draft_list
title: List your unpublished drafts (hosts)
